title: High-Protein Cucumber & Chicken Lunch Bowl
description: A no-cook shake-together lunch bowl of cucumber, red onion and cooked chicken in a garlicky yoghurt dressing.

time.label: About 2 min (no cooking with pre-cooked chicken)

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 254, rated 9/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @jessespt.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked. Garlic and lemon are to taste in the source.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator; fibre marked as his estimate. Excludes optional chickpeas.

items.note: Half a lemon's squeeze, or to taste

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Add the cucumber ({{cucumber}}), red onion ({{onion}}) and cooked chicken ({{chicken}}) to a 750ml container, plus the chickpeas ({{chickpeas}}) if using.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Add the Greek yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}), garlic, lemon juice and zest if using, olive oil ({{oil}}), salt and pepper.

steps.title: Shake
steps.text: Seal and shake until everything is coated. Eat straight away or refrigerate for meal prep.

notes.title: Meal prep
notes.text: The creator suggests storing it in the fridge for weekday lunches. No storage time is given; check before relying on it.
